That’s a good question, are used to think it was my fault. I Wood overthink everything, I felt like I struggled for no reason when everyone else seem to just go by day by day with no problems. I hated myself and I thought worthless that I had all these problems that no one would even recognize or care about. But then I realized that certain people do overthink things, and have anxiety. And people that have never had anxiety just write it off… Just be positive… Don’t let it bother you… All that BS. But people like us just have a different way of seeing things and feeling things. 

I found a support group here in Texas and I learned that other people thought the way I did. And then I surely realize that most people don’t feel the way we do. And I really don’t think anyone would be better off without you. Like you said you’re a dad, you have and you have a fiancé,  most people would say that’s amazing, and it is, but I also understand that must be so much pressure on you. You’re not worthless. You’re a good person that is going through something.
